_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: ZNC
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: ZNC is an IRC bouncer: it stays connected to your IRC networks and replays what you missed when you come back. The egg runs IRC and the web admin on the server's port.
startup: sed -i "/^<Listener listener0>/,/^<\/Listener>/s/^\tPort = .*/\tPort = {{SERVER_PORT}}/" data/configs/znc.conf || exit 1; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/container/pkgs/usr/lib/$(uname -m)-linux-gnu; exec ./pkgs/usr/bin/znc --foreground --datadir /home/container/data

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ZNC: installs ZNC from Debian 13's packages (with security updates,
# checked against Debian's signing keys) into pkgs/, and writes a first
# znc.conf. Your settings, users, networks and logs (data/) are never
# touched; reinstall to update.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# Debian 13's packages (with its security updates), fetched and checked by
# apt against Debian's signing keys, and unpacked into $1 (replaced only
# once the new one is complete). The runtime image is Debian 13 too.
debian_packages() {
    local dest=$1; shift
    local a="$work/apt"
    mkdir -p "$a/lists/partial" "$a/cache/archives/partial" "$a/dl" "$a/prefs"
    cat > "$a/sources.list" <<SRC
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian trixie main
deb http://deb.debian.org/debian trixie-updates main
deb http://security.debian.org/debian-security trixie-security main
SRC
    local opts=(-q -o Dir::Etc::SourceList="$a/sources.list" -o Dir::Etc::SourceParts=/nonexistent
        -o Dir::Etc::Preferences=/nonexistent -o Dir::Etc::PreferencesParts="$a/prefs"
        -o Dir::State::Lists="$a/lists" -o Dir::Cache="$a/cache" -o Dir::State::status=/dev/null
        -o Debug::NoLocking=1 -o APT::Sandbox::User=root)
    apt-get "${opts[@]}" update > "$a/update.log" 2>&1 || { tail -n 5 "$a/update.log"; fail "Debian's package servers can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."; }
    (cd "$a/dl" && apt-get "${opts[@]}" download "$@" > "$a/download.log" 2>&1) || { tail -n 5 "$a/download.log"; fail "Debian's packages couldn't be downloaded. Reinstall to try again."; }
    rm -rf "$dest.new" && mkdir -p "$dest.new"
    local f
    for f in "$a"/dl/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$f" "$dest.new"; done
    (cd "$a/dl" && ls *.deb) > "$dest.new/.raptor-packages"
    rm -rf "$dest" && mv "$dest.new" "$dest"
}

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) triplet=x86_64-linux-gnu ;;
    aarch64) triplet=aarch64-linux-gnu ;;
    *) fail "ZNC isn't packaged for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

if [ ! -f data/configs/znc.conf ] && [ -z "${ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
    fail "Set Admin password, then reinstall: ZNC needs a user to sign in as."
fi

echo "Downloading ZNC from Debian 13"
debian_packages pkgs znc libargon2-1 libsasl2-2 libsasl2-modules-db libdb5.3t64 libboost-locale1.83.0 libboost-thread1.83.0
version=$(sed -n 's/^znc_\([^_]*\)_.*/\1/p' pkgs/.raptor-packages)
[ -x pkgs/usr/bin/znc ] || fail "Debian's ZNC package didn't have ZNC where it should. Report this to Raptor."

# ZNC looks for modules and web skins in its data folder too: Debian's go
# there (replacing the last install's), next to any of your own.
mkdir -p data/modules data/webskins data/configs
if [ -f data/modules/.raptor-modules ]; then
    while IFS= read -r m; do [ -n "$m" ] && rm -rf -- "data/modules/$m"; done < data/modules/.raptor-modules
fi
(cd pkgs/usr/lib/znc && ls) > data/modules/.raptor-modules
(cd pkgs/usr/share/znc/modules && ls) >> data/modules/.raptor-modules
cp -r pkgs/usr/lib/znc/. pkgs/usr/share/znc/modules/. data/modules/
rm -rf data/webskins/_default_ data/webskins/dark-clouds data/webskins/forest data/webskins/ice
cp -r pkgs/usr/share/znc/webskins/. data/webskins/

# A first znc.conf: one listener on the server's port (IRC and the web
# admin), and the admin user, whose password is hashed here.
if [ ! -f data/configs/znc.conf ]; then
    user="${ADMIN_USER:-admin}"
    salt=$(head -c 30 /dev/urandom | base64 | tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' | head -c 20)
    hash=$(printf '%s%s' "$ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$salt" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
    (umask 077; cat > data/configs/znc.conf <<CONF
// ZNC's settings: https://wiki.znc.in/Configuration
// Edit them in the web admin (it saves this file), or here while ZNC is
// stopped. Raptor sets listener0's port to the server's at every start.
Version = ${version%%[-+]*}

<Listener listener0>
	AllowIRC = true
	AllowWeb = true
	IPv4 = true
	IPv6 = false
	Port = ${SERVER_PORT:-6697}
	SSL = false
	URIPrefix = /
</Listener>

LoadModule = webadmin

<User ${user}>
	Admin = true
	Nick = ${user}
	AltNick = ${user}_
	Ident = ${user}
	RealName = ${user}
	Buffer = 500
	LoadModule = chansaver
	LoadModule = controlpanel

	<Pass password>
		Method = SHA256
		Hash = ${hash}
		Salt = ${salt}
	</Pass>
</User>
CONF
)
    echo "Wrote a first znc.conf with the user $user."
fi
echo "Installed ZNC $version."

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The user created in the first znc.conf, who can sign in to the web admin.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The user's password, used when the first znc.conf is written. Change it later in the web admin.
